# Fair Marketing Solutions (FMS)

> Fair Marketing Solutions is a creative growth agency based in Iringa, Tanzania.
> It provides branding, social media management, content creation and premium
> website design for SMEs and growth-stage businesses across Tanzania — one
> coordinated partner with clear deliverables, transparent reporting and
> measurable results.

## Services
- Branding: logo & identity design, brand guidelines, company profiles, pitch decks, print & signage
- Social Media Management: content calendars, scheduling, community engagement, Meta Ads, monthly reports
- Content Creation: reels & TikTok videos, photography, videography, campaign graphics, branded templates
- Premium Website Design: fast conversion-focused websites, WhatsApp conversion setup, SEO, reporting & insights

## Packages (monthly retainers, 2026)
- Silver — TZS 450,000/month: 10 posters, 3 animated posters, 4 reels, 1 motion graphic, 2 platforms (Instagram + Facebook), 1 lead-generation campaign, Click-to-WhatsApp capture, monthly report
- Gold (most popular) — TZS 750,000/month: 18 posters, 6 animated posters, 6 reels, 3 motion graphics, 8 stories, 3 platforms (+TikTok), full-funnel campaign + retargeting, WhatsApp funnel + sales scripts, bi-weekly reports
- Platinum — TZS 1,300,000/month: 25 posters, 10 animated posters, 12 reels, 5 motion graphics, 12 stories, full brand refresh, 4 platforms, 2–3 simultaneous campaigns, WhatsApp automation/chatbot, dedicated strategist, weekly dashboards
- Tanzanite (enterprise) — custom-priced: full-scale production, campaign systems and a dedicated team, scoped around the client's goals

Note: recommended ad budgets are paid directly to Meta and are separate from package fees.

## Method
Six-step customer-acquisition system: Understand → Plan → Create → Advertise → Convert → Report.
